page.notes: The page is heavily faded and worn, and the index lines are largely unreadable. Only the large initial D, a few fragments such as "Theophilus" and "Tripartita", and the running head INDEX can be made out with any confidence; all other entries are marked illegible rather than guessed. The page numbers printed beside the entries (for example "17 b", "18 a", "2") cannot be read reliably, so they are not transcribed. The central ornament is a printer's device, not text. The mirrored lines in the lower half are show-through from the reverse side and are excluded. No page number, catchword or signature is clearly printed. A higher-resolution scan would be needed for an accurate transcription.
